description: REQ-C2 (`npm_install`) requires running `npm install` in ANICCA_HOME, and REQ-C3 (`git_checkout`) requires `git -C <anicca_home> checkout ...`. Both refer to `anicca_home`/`ANICCA_HOME` but the existing `execute_recipe` signature in `step3_recipe.py::28-35` is `execute_recipe(*, recipe, issue_kind, slot, cmd_map, timeout=30)` — there is NO `anicca_home` parameter and the spec's Section 3 Group C does not extend the signature. The spec is therefore not concretely implementable: the builder must choose between (i) adding a new kwarg to `execute_recipe` (breaks callers), (ii) reading `os.environ['ANICCA_HOME']` (introduces hidden global state — bad for the pure/shell split in verification-architecture.md), or (iii) deriving from `cmd_map`. The spec MUST pick one and state it as a signature-level REQ; leaving it implicit will produce inconsistent implementations and defeat PROP-C2/PROP-C3 verifiability.

evidence.snippet: REQ-C2 (`npm_install`): ... SHALL run `npm install` in ANICCA_HOME ... REQ-C3 (`git_checkout`): ... SHALL invoke `git -C <anicca_home> checkout <recipe.params.target>`
